confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Chinese city price levels; no live booking pages or current listings were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which have wider seasonal and venue variation. Cocktail and wine are estimated from typical urban Chinese bar and restaurant pricing relative to beer. The FX observation came from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rate page and was not confirmed by opening that page; a third-party table reported 0.6947 for 16 October 2026, so verify the RBA figure before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-to-large Yangtze River Delta cities such as Hangzhou, Nanjing and Wuxi, with prices somewhat below Shanghai and accommodation supply weighted toward business and domestic travel.
